data.description:
## Summary
Quantify current ~5% restore rate; define per-mode targets; rank fix options by expected prefill-token savings (parent: LP-0MTAQNB7J0094X71).

## Acceptance Criteria
- Current restore rate computed from F1 corpus with confidence interval.
- Target restore rate per mode (fast: TTFT/P95 priority; cheap: cost/local-utilization priority) with rationale.
- >=3 fix options (cap raise with timeout+cooldown plan, affinity/slot-ownership fix, restore-before-save ordering, skip-when-busy relaxation) each ranked by expected prefill-token savings and GPU-wedge risk.
- Metric section (parent AC #2).

- **Restore-reuse metric**: Current restore rate quantified (~5%) and a target restore rate per mode with fix options ranked by expected prefill-token savings. (covers parent AC #2)

## Minimal Implementation
- Compute restore_rate = restores/saves from F1 corpus, with CI.
- Derive expected prefill savings per option from token counts in corpus.
- Score options against GPU-wedge constraints from LP-0MS91DHPZ001VWQO.

## Key Files
- F1 corpus output
- proxy/proxy/session.py (persistence gating)
- proxy/config-fast.yaml, proxy/config-cheap.yaml (cap/threshold values)


## Dependencies
LP-0MTCMEOHB002X1JN (F2) and LP-0MTCMEV1G0022A35 (F3) root causes feed fix options.

## Deliverables
Metric + fix-ranking section of evaluation report.
data.title: F4: Restore-rate metric, per-mode targets & fix ranking

data.author: implement
data.comment: F4 implementation: metric module scripts/restore_metric_fix_ranking.py (Wilson CI + pool-based savings model) + 11 tests (proxy/tests/test_restore_metric_fix_ranking.py) + deliverable docs/dev/restore-rate-metric-fix-ranking.md. Key numbers (2026-08-26): proxy slot persistence restore rate 89.58% (831/926, CI 87.62-91.53%); llama native checkpoints 4.88% (154/3191, CI 4.14-5.63%) = the incident's ~5%; 43.8M prefill-token/day re-prefill pool. Per-mode targets: fast 95% (TTFT/P95 priority), cheap 90% (cost/local-utilization priority). Fix ranking by expected savings: (1) cap raise + timeout/cooldown 22.8M tokens/day (medium wedge risk), (2) affinity/ownership fix 3.3M (low), (3) restore-before-save 438K (none), (4) relax skip-when-busy 131K (low). F3's /slots 500s/staleness folded into affinity gain + tracked separately.
